observations: Photo 0 shows a white double-lid chest freezer with Haier Thermocool branding.
The freezer has a 5-star performance sticker on the front.
Photo 1 shows the side and rear of the freezer; the compressor compartment is open and appears dirty/rusty.
Photo 2 shows the interior of a silver single-door refrigerator, which is a different appliance from the one in the first two photos.
The items are placed outdoors on red soil, typical of a second-hand dealer's yard.
No model numbers or specification plates are legible in any of the photos.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification/rating plate on the back of the chest freezer.
Photo of the specification/rating plate on the back of the refrigerator.

response.reason: The listing contains two different appliances (a freezer and a fridge) but lacks the model numbers or capacity ratings necessary to distinguish between significantly different price points. Additionally, the condition of the freezer's compressor area suggests a high risk of mechanical failure.
